60 s table

Definitions

Alignment
The real run's series are on the wall clock, each simulated run's on its simulated clock. Each run is shifted so that 0 is the send of its first graded request (the earliest profiling-phase record with no error in its client export), and kept to its cell's window (). Points are interpolated onto one grid of the reports' step.
Panel points
As in CI's report: a histogram point (latency, batch, token panels) is a histogram estimate of the statistic over the rate window before it (60 s here); the cache panel's point is the reuse ratio over that window; queue and KV curves are sampled state.
Y axis
Fit cuts a panel whose peak is over 3× its 98th-percentile point at 1.25× that point and says so under the chart; Full shows every point; Log is logarithmic (zeros not drawn).
60 s table
One row per minute: a histogram or cache panel's point at the minute's end (so the statistic over that minute), a queue or KV panel's mean over the minute's samples. The last row is the mean of the rows.
Panel matrix
The mean of a panel's one-minute values, the simulated run's against the real run's, over the minutes the real run and every simulated run of the cell have a value in, so the cell's runs are compared over the same minutes; * marks fewer than all minutes (a minute with no decode output at all has no ITL point, say). Histogram panels use the selected statistic. A mean of per-minute P99s says in which minutes the long waits sit; it is not the run's P99. The "window mean" a panel's footer shows beside each run is that run's own mean over its minutes.
Request matrix
one_real.py's per-request metrics over the graded requests of each run (aiperf's TTFT, inter-token latency as TPOT, request latency, and InferenceX's agentic metrics). These are the figures the issues report. "in" / "OUT" marks a tail error inside or outside the real run's own 95% interval from 60 s send-block resamples; E2E paired is the median ratio over the requests both runs finished.
Simulated GPU panels
A simulated run's GPU panels are the predicted target device time on TP rank 0; a real run whose collector took no samples of them shows none.

Not shown

Directories the scan found that are not a complete cell (a run still going, a report not written yet).
